title: MailScreener
description: Sender screening model (Hey!-style). New senders go to screener_pending before reaching the imbox. The user decides once per sender — allow routes all future mail from that sender to the appropriate slot; block routes to screener_blocked permanently. The screener is the trust boundary for the inbox.

decision.description: pending=awaiting user decision. allowed=routes to imbox. allowed_as_feed=routes to Feed. allowed_as_paper_trail=routes to Paper Trail. blocked=never reaches inbox.

defaultRoutingSlot.description: Where allowed mail from this sender goes by default.

aiClassification.description: AI-suggested sender class to guide the screener decision.
